1-1.name: The Circumcision of Christ
1-1.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who madest thy blessed Son to be circumcised, and obedient to the law for man; Grant us the true circumcision of the Spirit; that, our hearts, and all our members, being mortified from all worldly and carnal lusts, we may in all things obey thy blessed will, through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

1-2.name: The Octave Day of St. Stephen
1-2.collect: GRANT us, O Lord, we beseech thee, to learn to love our enemies, by the example of thy first Martyr Saint Stephen, who prayed to thee for his persecutors. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-3.name: The Octave Day of St. John
1-3.collect: MERCIFUL Lord, we beseech thee to cast thy bright beams of light upon thy church; that it, being lightened by the doctrine of thy blessed Apostle and Evangelist John, may attain to thine everlasting gifts. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-4.name: The Octave Day of the Holy Innocents
1-4.collect: ALMIGHTY God, whose praise this day the young Innocents, thy witnesses, have confessed and shown forth, not in speaking but in dying: mortify and kill all vices in us, that in our conversation our life may express the faith, which with our tongues we do confess. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-5.name: Epiphany Even
1-5.collect: ENLIGHTEN our hearts, we beseech thee, O Lord, with the splendour of the coming festival; that thereby we may be enabled to free ourselves of the darkness of this world, and may also attain to the land of eternal brightness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-6.name: The Epiphany of Christ
1-6.collect: O GOD, who by the leading of a star didst manifest thy only-begotten Son to the Gentiles; Mercifully grant that we, who know thee now by faith, may after this life have the fruition of thy glorious Godhead; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

1-8.name: Sts. Lucian and Companions, MM.
1-8.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, grant us so worthily to venerate the merits of thine holy Martyrs Lucian and his Companions, that we may be set free from the dangers that beset us, and be made worthy of everlasting joys. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-10.name: Bl. William Laud, B.M.
1-10.collect: O GOD, in behalf of whose Church thy faithful servant and Bishop William suffered death at the hands of misguided and cruel men: mercifully grant, that we who call to mind his patient endurance to the end, may with him attain unto eternal rewards. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-12.name: St. Benedict Biscop, Abt. C.
1-12.collect: O GOD, by whose gift the blessed Abbot Benedict left all things that he might be made perfect: grant unto all those who have entered upon the path of evangelical perfection, that they may neither look back nor linger in the way; but hastening to thee without stumbling, may lay hold on life eternal. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-13.name: The Octave Day of the Epiphany
1-13.collect: O heavenly Father, whose blessed Son Jesus Christ did take our nature upon him, and was baptized for our sakes in the river Jordan: Mercifully grant that we being regenerate, and made thy children by adoption and grace, may also be partakers of thy Holy Spirit; through him whom thou didst send to be our Saviour and Redeemer, even the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

1-14.name: St. Hilary, B.C.D.
1-14.collect: ASSIST us, O Lord, in these our supplications; and at the intercession of blessed Hilary thy Confessor and Bishop, whose departure from this world we celebrate, graciously spread over us thine everlasting mercy. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-15.name: St. Paul the First Hermit, C.
St. Maurus, Abt. C.
1-15.collect: O GOD, who didst vouchsafe unto blessed Maurus thy Levite and Abbot to become a partaker of eternal glory: graciously grant us, at the intercession of him by whose example we have been instructed unto better living, an entrance into thine heavenly Kingdom. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-18.name: St. Prisca, V.M.
1-18.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that we who honour the birthday-feast of blessed Prisca thy Virgin and Martyr, may both rejoice in her yearly solemnity and profit by the example of so great a faith. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-19.name: St. Wulfstan, B.C.
1-19.collect: Pour forth upon us, O Lord, the Spirit of thy love; that by the intercession of blessed Wulfstan thy Confessor and Bishop, we may be found worthy to taste thy sweetness in eternal happiness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-20.name: Sts. Fabian, B.M., & Sebastian, M.
1-20.collect: O GOD, who didst strengthen thy blessed Martyrs Fabian and Sebastian with the valour of constancy in their passion: grant us, after their example, for love of thee to despise the prosperity of the world and to fear none of its adversity. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-21.name: St. Agnes, V.M.
1-21.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who dost choose the weak things of this world to confound the strong: mercifully grant, that we who devoutly keep the solemn feast of blessed Agnes thy Virgin and Martyr, may know the protection of her prayer before thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-22.name: St. Vincent, Deacon and Martyr
1-22.collect: Be ready, O Lord, to hear our supplications: that we who do acknowledge ourselves to be guilty of the sins whereof our conscience doth accuse us, may, at the intercession of thy blessed Martyr Vincent, be absolved. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-25.name: The Conversion of St. Paul the Apostle
1-25.collect: O GOD, who, through the preaching of the blessed Apostle Saint Paul, hast caused the light of the Gospel to shine throughout the world; Grant, we beseech thee, that we, having his wonderful conversion in remembrance, may show forth our thankfulness unto thee for the same, by following the holy doctrine which he taught; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

1-26.name: St. Polycarp, B.M.
1-26.collect: FULFIL, O Lord, the petitions of thy servants: who on this day devoutly reverence the passion of blessed Polycarp thy Bishop and Martyr; and accept us, together with him, as a whole burnt-offering dedicated unto thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-27.name: St. John Chrysostom
1-27.collect: WE beseech thee, O Lord, let thine heavenly grace continually increase thy Church; which thou hast vouchsafed to enlighten by the glorious doctrine and merits of blessed John Chrysostom, thy Confessor and Bishop. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-28.name: Sts. Peter Nolasco & Raymond of Pennyfort, CC.
1-28.collect: O GOD, who for an example of thy love didst divinely inspire holy Peter and Raymond to beget within thy Church a new family for the ransom of the faithful: grant through their intercession that we may be delivered from the slavery of sin, and enjoy freedom for evermore in our heavenly fatherland. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-29.name: St. Francis de Sales, B.C.D.
1-29.collect: O GOD, who didst will that blessed Francis thy Confessor and Bishop should be made all things to all men for their souls' salvation: mercifully grant, that we, being filled with the sweetness of thy love; may, by the guiding of his counsel and the support of his merits, attain unto joys eternal. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

1-30.name: Blessed Charles of England, King and Martyr
1-30.collect: BLESSED Lord, in whose sight the death of thy Saints is precious; we magnify thine holy Name for that abundant grace bestowed on the martyred sovereign, King Charles of England: by which he was enabled so cheerfully to follow the steps of his blessed Master and Saviour, in a constant meek bearing of all barbarous indignities, and at last resisting unto blood; and even then, according to the same pattern, praying for his murderers; let his memory, O Lord, be ever blessed among us, that we may follow the example of his patience and charity; And grant by his merits and prayers, that this our land may be ever defended from all disquietude, and thy mercy glorified in the forgiveness of our sins; and all for Jesus Christ his sake, our only Mediator and Advocate. Amen.

1-31.name: St. John Bosco, C.
1-31.collect: O GOD, who didst raise up holy John thy Confessor as a father and teacher of boys and youth, and through him with the Virgin Mary, his Helper, didst will new families to flourish in thy Church: grant, we beseech thee, that enkindled with the same fire of love, we may be enabled to seek souls and to serve thee alone. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-1.name: St. Ignatius of Antioch, B.M.
2-1.collect: GRANT, Almighty God, that as thy holy Bishop and Martyr Ignatius triumphed over suffering and despised death: we may, by his intercession, wax valiant in fight to the attaining of everlasting life. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-1.name: St. Brigid of Ireland, V.
2-1.collect: O GOD, whose dwelling-place is the pure in heart: grant that we who venerate the memory of holy Brigid, thy faithful spouse, may have grace to follow the example of her unspotted life. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-2.name: The Purification of St. Mary the Virgin
2-2.collect: ALMIGHTY and everliving God, we humbly beseech thy Majesty, that, as thy only-begotten Son was this day presented in the temple in substance of our flesh, so we may be presented unto thee with pure and clean hearts, by the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

2-3.name: St. Blasius, B.M.
2-3.collect: O GOD, who hast made this day holy and joyful unto us through the commemoration of blessed Blasius thy Martyr and Bishop: give ear to the prayers of thy family, and grant that we who celebrate his feast today, may by his merits and intercessions enjoy perpetual health of mind and body. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-3.name: St. Anskar, B.C.
2-3.collect: O GOD, who didst vouchsafe to send the blessed Bishop Anskar to preach thy glory to the heathen, that they might receive the adoption of sons: grant us, we beseech thee, by his interceding merits to continue steadfastly in thy will and service, that in our days the people who serve thee may increase both in number and merit. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-6.name: St. Titus, B.C.
2-6.collect: BLESSED Lord, who didst charge Saint Titus to speak the things that accord with sound doctrine, and to offer himself a pattern of good works: grant to all thy people to live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age, that they may with sure confidence look for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-9.name: St. Cyril of Alexandria, B.C.D.
2-9.collect: O GOD, who didst make blessed Cyril thy Confessor and Bishop an invincible defender of the divine motherhood of the Blessed Virgin Mary: grant at his intercession, that we who believe her to be indeed the Mother of God, may be saved by her maternal protection. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-10.name: St. Scholastica, V.
2-10.collect: O GOD, who for showing forth the way of innocence didst cause the soul of blessed Scholastica thy Virgin to enter heaven in the likeness of a dove: grant unto us, through her merits so innocently to live, that we may be worthy to attain unto the same joy and gladness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-12.name: St. Æthelwald of Lindisfarne, Abt. C.

2-13.name: St. Kentigern, B.C.
2-13.collect: O GOD, who through thy blessed Confessor Kentigern hast caused the light of the true faith to shine amongst barbarous nations: grant us, we beseech thee, so faithfully to follow the doctrine which he taught, that we may attain unto the brightness of everlasting glory. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-22.name: The Chair of St. Peter the Apostle at Antioch
2-22.collect: O GOD, who in giving the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven to thy blessed Apostle Peter, didst confer upon him the pontifical power of binding and loosing souls: graciously grant, that by the help of his intercession, we may be delivered from the bonds of our sins.

2-23.name: St. Peter Damian, B.C.D.
2-23.collect: GRANT us, we beseech thee, Almighty God, so to follow the warning and example of blessed Peter thy Confessor and Bishop: that through contempt for earthly things, we may obtain eternal joys. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-23.name: The Eve of St. Matthias
2-23.collect: WE beseech thee, Almighty God, that the devotion wherewith we do prevent the birthday Feast of blessed Matthias thine Apostle, may avail at his intercession to the increase of our help and protection. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

2-24.name: St. Matthias the Apostle
2-24.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who into the place of the traitor Judas didst choose thy faithful servant Matthias to be of the number of the twelve Apostles; Grant that thy Church, being alway preserved from false Apostles, may be ordered and guided by faithful and true pastors; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

2-28.name: St. Oswald of Worcester, B.C.
2-28.collect: O GOD, who hast consecrated this day by the holy passing of blessed Oswald thy Confessor and Bishop: graciously grant us to walk without stumbling in the way of his precepts, that we may be found worthy to share in his joys in the land of the living. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-1.name: St. David, B.C.
3-1.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who through thine holy Angel didst wondrously provide an habitation for thy blessed Confessor and Bishop David whilst yet unborn, and didst choose him to bring the true light and knowledge of thee to the people of Wales; mercifully grant unto us, that we who reverence his merits upon earth, may with him ever enjoy the vision of thee in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-2.name: St. Chad, B.C.
3-2.collect: O GOD, which art the Crown of thy chosen bishops, and the glorious victory of them that strive; who didst bestow upon blessed Chad the honour of episcopal dignity: mercifully grant that through his intercession, we may be united to him in everlasting bliss. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-3.name: St. Ælred, Abt. C.
3-3.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who ceasest not alike to teach and succour the children of thy Church: grant, we pray thee, at the intercession of thy blessed Abbot Saint Ælred, that, as thou hast given him unto thy faithful people to be the minister of their everlasting salvation, so they may by thy mercy be enabled both to perceive and to know the things that they ought to do, and also may have grace and power faithfully to fulfil the same. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-7.name: St. Thomas Aquinas, C.D.
3-7.collect: O GOD, who hast enlightened thy Church by the marvellous learning of blessed Thomas thy Confessor and Doctor, and hast made it fruitful by his holy labours: grant us, we beseech thee, both to receive his doctrine with understanding, and to fulfill in our lives the righteousness of his example. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-8.name: St. John of God, C.
3-8.collect: O GOD, who didst cause blessed John, on fire with thy love, to walk unhurt amidst the flames, and through him didst enrich thy Church with new offspring: grant by his supporting merits, that we may be purged of our vices through the fire of thy charity, and may be healed by thine eternal remedies. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-9.name: St. Frances of Rome, W.
3-9.collect: O GOD, who amongst other gifts of thy grace didst honour blessed Frances thine handmaid with the intimate companionship of an Angel: grant, we beseech thee, that by the help of her intercessions we may become worthy to attain unto the fellowship of the Angels. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-10.name: The Forty Martyrs of Sebaste
3-10.collect: MAY the fraternal crown of thy victorious Martyrs bring us joy, O Lord; that our faith may receive an increase of strength, and that we may also have the comfort of their manifold intercessions. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-12.name: St. Gregory the Great, B.C.D.
3-12.collect: ALMIGHTY and merciful Lord, who didst raise up in Gregory a servant of the servants of God, by whose labour the English people were renewed in the knowledge of the Catholic and Apostolic faith: Preserve in thy Church evermore a thankful remembrance of his zeal and devotion; that thy people, being fruitful in every good work, may receive with him and thy servants everywhere the crown of glory that fadeth not away. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-16.name: St. Joseph of Arimathea, C.
3-16.collect: O GOD, who didst give such grace unto thy servant Joseph that he boldly craved the body of Jesus, and with great reverence laid him in the rock-hewn sepulchre: grant, we beseech thee, that we likewise may be so emboldened for thee, as to do works meet for thy Kingdom. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-17.name: St. Patrick of Ireland, B.C.
3-17.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who in thy providence didst choose thy servant Patrick to be the apostle of the Irish people, that he might bring those who were wandering in darkness and error to the true light and knowledge of thee; Grant us, through his merits and prayers, so to walk in that light, that we may come at last to the light of everlasting life. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-18.name: St. Cyril of Jerusalem, B.C.D.
3-18.collect: GRANT us, we beseech thee, Almighty God, at the intercession of the blessed Bishop Cyril: so to know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom thou hast sent, that we may ever deserve to be numbered amongst the sheep that hear his voice. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-19.name: St. Joseph, Spouse of Blessed Mary
3-19.collect: O GOD, who in thine ineffable providence didst vouchsafe to choose holy Joseph to be the support and guardian of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of thine only-begotten Son: mercifully grant, by his merits and prayers, that set free from the toils of this life, we too may die the death of the righteous, embraced in the arms of mercy. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-20.name: St. Cuthbert, B.C.
3-20.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who didst call blessed Cuthbert from following the flock to be a shepherd of thy people: mercifully grant; that as he sought in dangerous and remote places those who had erred and strayed from thy ways, so by his merits and prayers we may be enabled to seek the indifferent and the lost, and to lead them back unto thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-21.name: St. Benedict, Abt. C.
3-21.collect: Almighty and everliving God, who as on this day didst deliver thy most blessed Confessor Benedict from the prison-house of the flesh, and didst exalt him unto thine heavenly Kingdom: grant, we beseech thee, unto us thy servants who celebrate his feast, remission of all our sins; that we, who with gladsome hearts rejoice in his glory, may through his merits and intercession be made partakers of his blessedness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-24.name: St. Gabriel the Archangel
3-24.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, unto whom thousands of Angels minister: grant, we beseech thee, that we, who on earth do honour blessed Gabriel the Archangel as the special minister of mankind's Restoration, may by his supporting prayers obtain in heaven the fruit of our Redemption. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-25.name: The Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
3-25.collect: We beseech thee, O Lord, pour thy grace into our hearts; that, as we have known the Incarnation of thy Son Jesus Christ by the message of an angel, so by his Cross and Passion we may be brought unto the glory of his resurrection; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

3-26.name: St. Dismas the Penitent Thief
3-26.collect: Almighty and merciful God, who hast prepared a way of salvation for the wicked: graciously show us thy love in the face of thine only-begotten Son Jesus Christ, whereby he drew unto himself the blessed Thief on the cross; that we likewise may be moved to true repentance, and attain the promise to be in Paradise with him, even the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, our Lord. Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-27.name: St. John Damascene, C.D.
3-27.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, who didst imbue blessed John with heavenly doctrine and wonderful fortitude of spirit for defending the veneration of holy Icons: grant unto us by his intercession and example, that we may both imitate the virtues, and experience the protection, of those whose images we honour. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-28.name: St. John Capistran, C.
3-28.collect: O God, who through blessed John didst make thy faithful people, in the power of the most holy Name of Jesus, to triumph over the enemies of the Cross; grant at his intercession, we beseech thee, that having overcome the snares of our spiritual foes, we may be accounted worthy to receive from thee the crown of righteousness. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-29.name: St. Nicodemus, C.
3-29.collect: O God, who by thy prevenient grace didst make timidity to flower into boldness and loving devotion in thy disciple Nicodemus: grant, we beseech thee, that after his example, we may both learn the truths of the Spirit, and also grow in love of thee. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

3-30.name: Blessed John Keble, P.C.
3-30.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, mercifully grant that in all time of our testing we may know thy presence and obey thy will; that, following the example of thy servant John Keble, we may accomplish with integrity and courage that which thou givest us to do, and endure joyfully that which thou givest us to suffer. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-3.name: St. Richard, B.C.
4-3.collect: O God, who hast made thy Church resplendent with the saintly life and glorious miracles of blessed Richard, thy Confessor and Bishop: grant, we beseech thee, that by his intercession, we thine humble servants may attain to the glory of everlasting felicity. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-4.name: St. Isidore, B.C.D.
4-4.collect: O God, who didst give blessed Isidore unto thy people as a minister of eternal salvation: grant, we beseech thee, that we may be worthy to have him as our intercessor in heaven, whom we had as our teacher of life here upon earth. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-5.name: St. Vincent Ferrer, C.
4-5.collect: O God, who through the wonderful preaching of blessed Vincent thy Confessor didst grant that a multitude of Gentiles should come to the knowledge of thy Name: vouchsafe, we beseech thee, that we may be worthy to have in heaven as our Rewarder, him who he proclaimed shall come on earth as our Judge, even Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord. Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-11.name: St. Leo the Great, B.C.D.
4-11.collect: Almighty, everlasting God, whose servant Leo steadfastly confessed thy Son our Saviour Jesus Christ to be Very God and Very Man: grant that we may hold fast to this faith, and evermore magnify his holy Name. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-13.name: St. Justin Martyr
4-13.collect: O God, who through the foolishness of the Cross didst marvellously teach blessed Justin Martyr the excellent knowledge of Jesus Christ: grant at his petition, that repelling the manifold errors which beset us, we may attain unto constancy of faith. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-19.name: St. Alphege, B.M.
4-19.collect: O God, who didst adorn blessed Alphege thy Confessor with the dignity of priesthood and the palm of martyrdom: mercifully grant, that we being aided by his prayers, may be enabled to rejoice with him in eternal happiness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-23.name: St. George, M.
4-23.collect: O God, who makest us glad with the merits and intercession of blessed George thy Martyr: mercifully grant, that we who by his aid implore thy bounty; may by the abundance of thy grace receive the same. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-25.name: St. Mark the Evangelist
4-25.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who hast instructed thy holy Church with the heavenly doctrine of thy Evangelist Saint Mark; Give us grace that, being not like children carried away with every blast of vain doctrine, we may be established in the truth of thy holy Gospel; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

4-27.name: St. Peter Canisius, C.D.
4-27.collect: O God, who with valour and learning didst strengthen blessed Peter thy Confessor for defending the Catholic Faith: mercifully grant, that by his example and teaching, the erring may again look to their salvation, and the faithful persevere in their confession of the truth. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-28.name: St. Paul of the Cross, C.
4-28.collect: O Lord Jesus Christ, who didst endue holy Paul with singular love in preaching the mystery of the Cross, and didst will that through him a new family should grow up in thy Church: grant us through his intercession, that by continually meditating here on earth upon thy Passion, we may be made worthy to attain unto its fruition in heaven. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-29.name: St. Peter Martyr
4-29.collect: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God; that with fitting devotion we may follow the faith of blessed Peter thy Martyr; who for spreading abroad the same faith, deserved to obtain the victory of martyrdom. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

4-30.name: St. Catherine of Siena, V.
4-30.collect: O God, who didst vouchsafe to blessed Catherine the virtues of chastity and patience in exceeding great measure, and didst enable her both to conquer the assaults of evil spirits, and to remain unshaken in the love of thy Name: grant, we beseech thee; that following her example we may trample underfoot the wickedness of this world, and overcome the snares of our ghostly enemies, so that at length we may attain unto thy glorious kingdom. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-1.name: St. Philip & St. James, Apostles
5-1.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, whom truly to know is everlasting life; Grant us perfectly to know thy Son Jesus Christ to be the way, the truth, and the life; that, following the steps of thy holy Apostles, Saint Philip and Saint James, we may stedfastly walk in the way that leadeth to eternal life; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

5-2.name: St. Athanasius, B.C.D.
5-2.collect: Grant us grace, we beseech thee, Almighty God: that we may believe in our hearts, and confess with our lips, the true faith in thy Consubstantial Word; like unto that which thy blessed Bishop Athanasius maintained with so marvellous a steadfastness, and amid such innumerable labours and persecutions. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-3.name: Invention of the Holy Cross
5-3.collect: O God, who in the glorious discovery of thy salvation-bringing Cross didst renew the wonders of thy Passion: grant, that through the ransom once paid on that Tree of Life, we may obtain election unto life eternal. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-4.name: St. Monica, W.
5-4.collect: O God, the comforter of them that mourn, and the salvation of all such as do hope in thee, who didst mercifully accept the loving tears of blessed Monica for the conversion of her son Augustine: grant us, at the intercession of them both, to so lament our sins as to gain thy grace and pardon. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-5.name: The Conversion of St. Augustine
5-5.collect: O God, who hast adorned this day with the wondrous Conversion of blessed Augustine, thy Confessor and Bishop: grant, we beseech thee, that as in thrusting aside the errors of heresy he was a bulwark unto thy Church, so by his praying for us he may be our defense against the assaults of the ancient enemy. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-6.name: St. John before the Latin Gate
5-6.collect: O God, who seest that we are sore beset with evils on every side: grant, we beseech thee, that the glorious intercession of blessed John thine Apostle and Evangelist may be our shield and protection. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-7.name: St. John of Beverley, B.C.
5-7.collect: O God, who hast consecrated this day by the passing of blessed John thy Confessor and Bishop: grant unto thy Church so worthily to rejoice in his solemnity, that by his example and merits we may be helped and sustained at thy mercy seat. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-9.name: St. Gregory Nazianzus, B.C.D.
5-9.collect: Almighty God, who hast revealed to thy Church thine eternal Being of glorious majesty and perfect love as one God in Trinity of Persons; grant us grace that, like thy blessed Bishop Gregory, we may continue steadfast in the confession of this faith, and constant in the true worshipping of thee: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost; who livest and reignest world without end. Amen.

5-11.name: Sts. Domitilla, Nereus, & Achilleus, MM.
5-11.collect: O God, may the blessed festival of thy Martyrs Domitilla, Nereus, and Achilleus ever support us in thy service, that we may thereby be rendered meet to walk after thy commandments. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-12.name: St. Pancras, M.
5-12.collect: We beseech thee, O Lord our God; that like as the tender age of thy blessed Martyr Pancras, supported by thy protection, manfully overcame the rage of the wicked and all the torments to his body, so our weakness may likewise be strengthened by the power of thy virtue. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-14.name: St. Pachomius, Abt. C.
5-14.collect: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, that the prayers of thine holy Abbot Pachomius may commend us unto thee; that we, who have no power of ourselves to help ourselves, may by his advocacy find favour in thy sight. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-15.name: St. Jean-Baptiste de La Salle, C.
5-15.collect: O God, who didst raise up thy blessed Confessor Jean-Baptiste to set forward the Christian teaching of the poor, and to confirm the young in the way of truth, and through him didst gather together a new family in thy Church: mercifully grant, that by his intercession and example, we may be fervent in zeal for thy glory and for the saving of souls, and be found worthy to share his crown in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-16.name: St. Brendan the Navigator, Abt. C.
5-16.collect: O God, whose blessed Son became poor that we through his poverty might be rich: deliver us, we pray thee, from an inordinate love of worldly things; that, holpen by the prayers of thy blessed Abbot Brendan, we may serve thee with singleness of heart, and attain unto the riches of the age to come. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-16.name: St. Simon Stock, C.
5-16.collect: We pray thee, O Lord, that we who do profess ourselves servants of thee and of thy Virgin Mother, may evermore rejoice in the festival of blessed Simon thy Confessor: and grant that, like as in him thou hast vouchsafed a proof of the protection thou dost grant us, so we may be enabled to obtain the rewards of eternal life whereunto thou hast prepared us. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-19.name: St. Dunstan, B.C.
5-19.collect: O God, who didst richly endow thy Bishop Dunstan with a most excellent skill in music and a fervent zeal for the reformation of thy Church; make us, we beseech thee, in like manner so to labour for the adornment of thy temple and the advancement of true relgion. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-20.name: St. Bernardine of Siena, C.
5-20.collect: O Lord Jesus, who didst give unto blessed Bernardine thy Confessor an exceeding love of thine holy Name: we beseech thee, through his merits and intercession, bountifully to pour upon us the spirit of thy love. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-24.name: St. Vincent of Lerins, C.
5-24.collect: O God, who didst raise up thy blessed Confessor Vincent to proclaim the rule of faith: grant that all thy people may steadfastly witness to the fulness of Catholic truth; that the same may be received everywhere, always, and by all, even as thou hast taught us. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-25.name: St. Aldhelm, B.C.
5-25.collect: O God, who as on this day didst exalt thy blessed Bishop Saint Aldhelm to everlasting felicity: we pray thee, that by his merits and intercession, thy mercy may bring us unto that place whither he is gone before. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-26.name: St. Augustine of Canterbury, B.C.
5-26.collect: O God, who didst vouchsafe to give blessed Augustine thy Bishop to be an enlightener of the English people: grant, we beseech thee, that we who on earth proclaim his merits, may inwardly perceive the benefit of his prayers for us on high. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-27.name: St. Bede the Venerable, P.C.D.
5-27.collect: O God, who by the learning of blessed Bede thy Confessor and Doctor hast made thy Church illustrious: mercifully grant unto us thy servants, that we may ever be illuminated by his wisdom and aided by his merits. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-28.name: St. Philip Neri, C.
5-28.collect: O God, who hast exalted blessed Philip thy Confessor to the glory of thy Saints: mercifully grant, that as we rejoice in his festival, so we may profit by the example of his virtues. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

5-30.name: St. Joan of Arc, V.
5-30.collect: O God, who didst wondrously raise up blessed Joan thy Virgin for the defense of faith and fatherland: grant, we beseech thee, through her intercession that thy Church, having overcome the devices of the enemy, may enjoy perpetual peace. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-2.name: The Martyrs of Lyons
6-2.collect: O God, who didst arm blessed Pothinus, Blandina, and their Companions with heavenly might to endure divers kinds of torments: grant that we, being rooted and grounded in thy love, may thereby also be enabled to endure all the sufferings of this present time. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-5.name: St. Boniface, B.M. & Companions, MM.
6-5.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, who didst confer upon blessed Boniface and his Companions the victory of martyrdom: grant, we beseech thee, that thou wilt vouchsafe by their merits to grant us thy pardon, as thou hast vouchsafed to bestow upon them the crown of glory. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-6.name: St. Norbert, B.C.
6-6.collect: O God, who didst make blessed Norbert thy Confessor and Bishop an illustrious preacher of thy Word, and through him didst render thy Church fruitful with new offspring: grant, we beseech thee, that through his supporting merits we may be enabled by thy help to practice what he taught, both in word and deed. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-9.name: St. Columba of Iona, Abt. C.
6-9.collect: We pray thee, O Lord, pour into our hearts the desire for heavenly glory; and grant that we, bringing our sheaves with us, may thither attain where thine holy Abbot Columba shineth like a golden star before thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-9.name: The First Book of Common Prayer, 1549
6-9.collect: Almighty and everliving God, who didst guide thy servant Thomas Cranmer, with others, to render the worship of thy Church in a language understanded of the people: Make us ever thankful for this our heritage, and help us so to pray in the Spirit and with the understanding also, that we may worthily magnify thy holy name. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-10.name: St. Margaret of Scotland, Q.W.
6-10.collect: O God, who madest blessed Queen Margaret wonderful for love toward the poor: grant that through her intercession and example, thy charity may increase evermore within our hearts. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-11.name: St. Barnabas the Apostle
6-11.collect: O LORD God Almighty, who didst endue thy holy Apostle Barnabas with singular gifts of the Holy Ghost; Leave us not, we beseech thee, destitute of thy manifold gifts, nor yet of grace to use them alway to thy honour and glory; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

6-13.name: St. Anthony of Padua, C.D.
6-13.collect: O Lord, may the solemn festival of thine holy Confessor and Doctor Anthony rejoice thy Church: that she may ever be defended by spiritual help, and merit the enjoyment of eternal bliss. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-14.name: St. Basil the Great, B.C.D.
6-14.collect: O God, who didst vouchsafe to choose blessed Basil thy Confessor to be a preeminent teacher and proclaimer of the Catholic Faith: grant, we beseech thee, at his intercession, that we may have grace to cast away the chains of our sins, and serve thee, O Lord, in singleness of heart. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-18.name: St. Ephrem the Syrian, C.D.
6-18.collect: O God, who didst will to illumine thy Church with the wonderful learning and splendid merits of blessed Ephrem thy Confessor and Doctor: we humbly beseech thee, at his intercession, that thou wouldest ever defend it by thy continual power against the snares of error and wickedness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-18.name: St. Isaac the Syrian, C.
6-18.collect: O God, who desirest not the death of a sinner, but rather will have all men to be saved and come unto the knowledge of the truth; grant, we beseech thee, that the intercession of Blessed Isaac thy Confessor may commend us unto thine excellent love: that we may at the last be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-19.name: Sts. Gervasius & Protasius, MM.
6-19.collect: O God, who makest us glad by the yearly solemnity of thine holy Martyrs Gervasius and Protasius: mercifully grant, that we who glory in their merits may be enkindled by their examples. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-20.name: St. Edward the Martyr, K.M.
6-20.collect: O God, triumphant in thine eternal Kingdom, graciously look upon thy family celebrating the festivity of Edward, thy King and Martyr: and grant, that as thou dost vouchsafe to glorify him with the rewards of heaven, so at his prayer thou wouldest make us worthy to be enrolled as heirs of everlasting felicity. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-21.name: St. Aloysius Gonzaga, C.
6-21.collect: O God, the distributor of heavenly gifts, who in the angelic youth of Aloysius didst unite a wonderful innocence of life with an equal spirit of penitence: grant, by his merits and prayers, that although we have not followed after his innocence, we may nevertheless imitate his penitence. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-22.name: St. Alban, Protomartyr of England
6-22.collect: O God, who hast hallowed this day by the martyrdom of blessed Alban: grant, we beseech thee, that he, in whose yearly festival we rejoice, may continually aid us by his prayers. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-23.name: Eve of St. John Baptist
6-23.collect: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God; that thine household may walk in the way of salvation: and by following the exhortations of blessed John thy Forerunner, may surely attain unto him whom he foretold, even Jesus Christ, thy Son, our Lord. Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-24.name: Nativity of St. John Baptist
6-24.collect: ALMIGHTY God, by whose providence thy servant John Baptist was wonderfully born, and sent to prepare the way of thy Son our Saviour by preaching repentance; Make us so to follow his doctrine and holy life, that we may truly repent according to his preaching; and after his example constantly speak the truth, boldly rebuke vice, and patiently suffer for the truth's sake; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

6-26.name: Sts. John & Paul, MM.
6-26.collect: We beseech thee, Almighty God, that today we may receive the two-fold joy of this feast in the triumph of blessed John and Paul, who were made brethren indeed by the same faith and the same martyrdom. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-28.name: Eve of St. Peter
6-28.collect: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that thou wouldest not permit thy Church, which thou hast firmly established upon the Rock of the Apostolic Confession, to be shaken by any disturbance; for the sake of thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-28.name: St. Irenæus, B., & Companions, MM.
6-28.collect: O God, who didst give holy Irenæus to thy Church as a worthy Shepherd and eminent Teacher: grant, we beseech thee, that as when he laid down his life for his sheep he had them with him as partners in his passion, so we being renewed by his faith and doctrine, may ever follow him both in heart and deed. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-29.name: St. Peter the Apostle
6-29.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who by thy Son Jesus Christ didst give to thy Apostle Saint Peter many excellent gifts, and commandedst him earnestly to feed thy flock; Make, we beseech thee, all Bishops and Pastors diligently to preach thy holy Word, and the people obediently to follow the same, that they may receive the crown of everlasting glory; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

6-30.name: Commemoration of St. Paul the Apostle
6-30.collect: O God, who didst instruct the multitude of the Gentiles by the doctrine of blessed Paul the Apostle: grant unto us, we beseech thee, that we who this day call him to remembrance, may feel the effectual benefit of his intercession. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

6-30.name: St. Peter
6-30.collect: O GOD, who in giving the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven to thy blessed Apostle Peter, didst confer upon him the pontifical power of binding and loosing souls: graciously grant, that by the help of his intercession, we may be delivered from the bonds of our sins. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-1.name: The Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ
7-1.collect: Almighty and everlasting God, who didst ordain thine only-begotten Son to be the Redeemer of the world, and hast vouchsafed to reconcile us by his Blood: mercifully grant that we who here rejoice to honour that Blood, the price of our salvation, may be defended by its power in this present world, and rejoice in the everlasting fruits thereof in the world to come. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-1.name: Octave Day of St. John Baptist
7-1.collect: O GOD, who hast made this day honourable for us by the Nativity of blessed John: grant unto thy people the grace of spiritual joys, and direct the souls of all the faithful into the way of eternal salvation. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-2.name: The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
7-2.collect: O God, who didst move the most holy Virgin Mary, Mother of thine only-begotten Son, to visit blessed Elisabeth for the grace of mutual consolation: mercifully grant, that we thy servants may be ofttimes encouraged by her visitations, and sheltered by thy protecting power from all adversities. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-4.name: Independence Day
7-4.collect: O ETERNAL God, through whose mighty power our fathers won their liberties of old; Grant, we beseech thee, that we and all the people of this land may have grace to maintain these liberties in righteousness and peace; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

7-5.name: St. Vladimir, K.M.
7-5.collect: O GOD, who madest blessed Vladimir to shine forth amongst earthly rulers as a worthy instrument in the spread of thy Kingdom on earth: grant, we beseech thee, that encouraged by his holy and penitent life, we may, holpen by his prayer before thee, attain unto our true Fatherland in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-6.name: The Octave Day of Sts. Peter & Paul, Apostles
7-6.collect: O GOD, whose right hand upheld blessed Peter lest he should sink beneath the waves; and delivered his fellow-Apostle Paul from the depth of the sea when thrice he suffered shipwreck: mercifully hear us, and grant that by the merits of them both, we may attain unto the glory of eternal life. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-7.name: Sts. Cyril & Methodius, BB.CC.
7-7.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who through thy blessed Bishops and Confessors Cyril and Methodius didst vouchsafe to the Slavic peoples the knowledge of thy Name: grant that we, who glory in their commemoration, may be joined unto their fellowship. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-9.name: St. John Fisher, B.M. & St. Thomas More, C.M.
7-9.collect: O GOD, who amid the pleasures of this world, and likewise amidst the sorrows of imprisonment and death, didst grant thy blessed Martyrs John and Thomas grace with cheerfulness and courage to embrace thy Cross: mercifully grant, that by their intercession and example, we may be counted worthy readily to strive for faith and righteousness, and to attain in gladness unto everlasting felicity. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-10.name: Seven Martyr Brothers
7-10.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God: that, like as we have known thy glorious Martyrs to be constant in their confession of thy Faith; so we may feel the succour of their loving intercession. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-11.name: Translation of St. Benedict of Nursia
7-11.collect: O GOD, who didst vouchsafe to fill thy most blessed Confessor Benedict with the spirit of all the righteous: grant unto us thy servants who celebrate his festival that, being filled with the same spirit, we may faithfully accomplish that which thou hast enabled us to promise. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-15.name: St. Swithun, B.C.
7-15.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who hast made this day honourable unto us by the memorial of blessed Swithun thy Confessor and Bishop: grant to thy Church such joy in celebrating this feast, that we who reverence his festival on earth may by his intercession be lifted up to heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-16.name: St. Osmund, B.C.
7-16.collect: O GOD, whose miracles of old we perceive to shine forth even in our own time to the glory and praise of thy Name, and to the honour of thine holy Confessor and Bishop Osmund: mercifully grant, that we who keep his festival may by his prayers both glorify thee in this present world, and be accounted worthy to enjoy thee in the world to come. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-19.name: St. Vincent de Paul, C.
7-19.collect: O GOD, who didst strengthen blessed Vincent with Apostolic power for preaching the Gospel to the poor, and for promoting the worthiness of the clergy: grant, we beseech thee, that we who reverence his pious deeds may also be taught by the example of his virtues. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-20.name: St. Margaret of Antioch, V.M.
7-20.collect: O GOD, who through the victory of martyrdom hast caused the blessed Virgin Margaret as on this day to come unto the heavenly Kingdom: grant to us, we beseech thee, that following her example, we may be counted worthy to attain unto glory with thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-22.name: St. Mary Magdalene
7-22.collect: GRANT unto us, O most merciful Father; that as blessed Mary Magdalene in loving thine only-begotten Son above all things obtained forgiveness of her sins; so may she ever entreat for us, at thy mercy-seat, an habitation in everlasting blessedness. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-24.name: Eve of St. James
7-24.collect: WE beseech thee, Almighty God, that the devotion wherewith we do prevent the birthday Feast of blessed James thine Apostle, may avail at his intercession to the increase of our help and protection. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-24.name: St. Christopher, M.
7-24.collect: O GOD, who didst suffer the blessed Martyr Christopher to be a servant worthy unto thee; grant, of thy goodness, through his merits, that we may be enabled to carry Christ within us with whole intent of mind and affection of heart. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-25.name: St. James the Apostle
7-25.collect: GRANT, O merciful God, that, as thine holy Apostle Saint James, leaving his father and all that he had, without delay was obedient unto the calling of thy Son Jesus Christ, and followed him; so we, forsaking all worldly and carnal affections, may be evermore ready to follow thy holy commandments; through the same Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

7-26.name: St. Anne, Mother of Blessed Mary
7-26.collect: O GOD, who on this day didst exalt blessed Anne, the honoured parent of thy dearly-beloved Mother, to the joys of endless life: grant that we also may attain to eternal blessedness, for her merits' sake, of whose saving offspring thou didst vouchsafe to become incarnate for the salvation of the world. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-29.name: St. Martha, V.
7-29.collect: ALMIGHTY and most merciful God, whose Son did vouchsafe to be entertained in the home of blessed Martha: grant, we beseech thee, by the merits of her who lovingly entertained him, that we of thy mercy may be received into our heavenly home. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-29.name: St. Olaf, K.M.
7-29.collect: O GOD, triumphant in thine eternal Kingdom, graciously look upon thy family celebrating the festivity of Olaf, thy King and Martyr: and grant, that as thou dost vouchsafe to glorify him with the rewards of heaven, so at his prayer thou wouldest make us worthy to be enrolled as heirs of everlasting felicity. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-31.name: St. Ignatius Loyola, P.C.
7-31.collect: O GOD, who to set forward the greater glory of thy Name didst reinforce the Church with a new soldiery through blessed Ignatius: grant, that contending on earth with his help and after his example, we may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

7-31.name: St. Germanus, B.C.
7-31.collect: HEAR us, O God our Saviour; and because our own voices do not deserve to be heard, may the intercession of holy Germanus thy Confessor and Bishop, we beseech thee, be acceptable in our behalf. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-1.name: St. Peter's Chains
8-1.collect: O GOD, who didst deliver thy holy Apostle Saint Peter from his chains and suffer him to depart unhurt: vouchsafe, we pray thee; to deliver us from the chains of our sins, and of thy mercy preserve us from all evil. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-1.name: The Holy Maccabees, MM.
8-1.collect: MAY the fraternal crown of thy victorious Martyrs bring us joy, O Lord; that our faith may receive an increase of strength, and that we may also have the comfort of their manifold intercessions. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-2.name: St. Alphonsus Liguori, B.C.D.
8-2.collect: O GOD, who didst enkindle in blessed Alphonsus thy Confessor and Bishop a burning zeal for the salvation of souls, and through him didst make thy Church fruitful with new offspring: grant, we beseech thee, that taught by his saving counsels and strengthened by his example, we may joyfully attain unto thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-4.name: St. Dominic, C.
8-4.collect: O GOD, who hast caused thy Church to shine with the saintly life and preaching of thy blessed Confessor Dominic; grant, at his intercession: that thy faithful people may never fail to increase in spiritual gifts, nor yet be left destitute of thy temporal aid. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-5.name: St. Oswald of Northumbria, K.M.
8-5.collect: ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who makest us to joy with holy gladness in the passion of thy servant Oswald: pour into our hearts an increase of thy fear and love; and grant that we, who celebrate his holy blood-shedding on earth, may perceive the help of his prayers for us in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-5.name: Dedication of St. Mary of the Snows
8-5.collect: O LORD God Almighty, we beseech thee to keep us thy servants both outwardly in our bodies, and inwardly in our souls: that by the glorious intercession of blessed Mary ever-virgin, we may be delivered from our present heaviness and attain in the end to everlasting gladness. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-6.name: The Transfiguration of our Lord Jesus Christ
8-6.collect: O GOD, who on the mount didst reveal to chosen witnesses thine only-begotten Son wonderfully transfigured, in raiment white and glistering; Mercifully grant that we, being delivered from the disquietude of this world, may be permitted to behold the King in his beauty, who with thee, O Father, and thee, O Holy Ghost, liveth and reigneth, one God, world without end. Amen.

8-7.name: The Sweetest Name of Jesus
8-7.collect: O GOD, who hast made the most glorious Name of thine only-begotten Son Jesus Christ to be sweet and lovely to thy faithful people, but full of terror to evil spirits: mercifully grant, that all who devoutly venerate this Name of Jesus upon earth may enjoy the sweetness of consolation in this present world, and in the world to come attain unto the glory of everlasting bliss. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-7.name: Blessed John Mason Neale
8-7.collect: O GOD, who by thy Holy Spirit hast given unto one man a word of wisdom, and to another a word of knowledge, and to another the gift of tongues: We praise thy Name for the gifts of grace manifested in thy servant John, and we pray that thy Church may never be destitute of the same. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-9.name: St. John Mary Vianney, C.
8-9.collect: ALMIGHTY and most merciful God, who didst make holy John Mary wonderful in pastoral zeal and in unflagging ardour for prayer and penitence: grant, we beseech thee, that by his example and intercession, we may be able to win the souls of our brethren to Christ, and together with them to obtain eternal glory. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-10.name: St. Laurence, M.
8-10.collect: GRANT us, we beseech thee, Almighty God, with due reverence and fervent faith to celebrate the victory of blessed Laurence, thy Martyr; which, in despite of the flames, he accomplished on earth: whose glorious triumph now shines forth in the perpetual light of heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-12.name: St. Clare, V.
8-12.collect: HEAR us, O God our Saviour; that as we do rejoice in the festivity of blessed Clare thy Virgin, so we may be taught by the influence of her loving devotion. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-14.name: Assumption Even
8-14.collect: O GOD, who didst vouchsafe to choose the virgin womb of blessed Mary as a shrine wherein thou mightest rest: grant, we beseech thee, that under her protection, we may joyfully assist at her coming solemnity. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-14.name: St. Tarcisius, M.
8-14.collect: WE beseech thee, O Lord our God, that like as the tender age of thy blessed Martyr Tarcisius, supported by thy protection, manfully overcame the rage of the wicked and all the torments to his body, so our weakness may likewise be strengthened by the power of thy virtue. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-15.name: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
8-15.collect: GRANT, O Lord, we beseech thee, that this august solemnity may bring us everlasting aid: forasmuch as on this day the holy Mother of God endured the pains of death, and yet could not be holden of it, seeing that of her substance thy Son our Lord became incarnate. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-16.name: St. Joachim, Father of Blessed Mary
8-16.collect: O GOD, who didst choose blessed Joachim before all thy Saints to be the father of her who bore thy Son: grant, we beseech thee, that as we do hold his festival in honour, so we may ever experience his protection. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-17.name: St. Hyacinth, C.
8-17.collect: O God, who didst make blessed Hyacinth thy Confessor preëminent amongst people of divers nations by the holiness of his deeds and the glory of his miracles: grant us, we beseech thee, that we may by his example amend our lives for the better, and through his help be protected against all things contrary. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-18.name: St. Helena, Q.W.
8-18.collect: O Lord Jesus Christ, who didst reveal to blessed Helena the place where thy Cross lay hidden, that through her thy Church might be enriched with this precious Treasure: grant us at her intercession, that by the ransom of that life-giving Wood, we may obtain the rewards of everlasting salvation. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-20.name: St. Bernard, Abt.C.D.
8-20.collect: HEARKEN, O Lord, unto our prayers which we offer unto thee on the solemnity of holy Bernard thy Confessor and Doctor; and by the prayers of him who worthily attained to serve thee, do thou absolve us from all our sins. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-21.name: St. Jane Frances de Chantal, W.
8-21.collect: ALMIGHTY and most merciful God, who madest blessed Jane Frances, enkindled with thy love, to walk with wondrous fortitude through all life's paths in the way of perfection, and who by her didst will to illumine thy Church with new offspring: grant, through her merits and prayers; that we who, knowing our own weakness, do trust only in thy strength, may overcome all adversities by the help of thine heavenly grace. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-22.name: The Octave Day of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
8-22.collect: GRANT, O Lord, we beseech thee, that this august solemnity may bring us everlasting aid: forasmuch as on this day the holy Mother of God endured the pains of death, and yet could not be holden of it, seeing that of her substance thy Son our Lord became incarnate. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-23.name: Eve of St. Bartholomew
8-23.collect: WE beseech thee, Almighty God, that the devotion wherewith we do prevent the birthday Feast of blessed Bartholomew thine Apostle, may avail at his intercession to the increase of our help and protection. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-24.name: St. Bartholomew the Apostle
8-24.collect: O ALMIGHTY and everlasting God, who didst give to thine Apostle Bartholomew grace truly to believe and to preach thy Word; Grant, we beseech thee, unto thy Church, to love that Word which he believed, and both to preach and receive the same; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

8-25.name: St. Louis of France, K.C.
8-25.collect: O GOD, who didst translate blessed Louis thy Confessor from an earthly realm to the glory of thine heavenly Kingdom: make us, we beseech thee, through his merits and intercession, to be companions of the King of kings, thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-28.name: St. Augustine of Hippo, B.C.D.
8-28.collect: O God, who didst give blessed Augustine as a Catholic Teacher unto thy Church, to the expounding of the mysteries of Holy Scripture: grant that we may ever be enlightened by his teaching, and upholden by his prayers. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-29.name: The Beheading of St. John Baptist
8-29.collect: GRANT, O Lord, we beseech thee, that the holy solemnity of blessed John Baptist, thy Martyr, may obtain for us the gift of thy saving help. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-30.name: St. Rose of Lima, V.
8-30.collect: ALMIGHTY God, the giver of all good things, who in preventing blessed Rose with the dew of thine heavenly grace didst will that she should bloom in the Indies in the beauty of virginity and patience: grant unto us thy servants, that hastening after the savour of her sweetness, we may deserve to be made the good savour of Christ. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

8-31.name: St. Aidan, B.C.
8-31.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who in thy providence didst choose thy blessed servant Aidan to be an apostle to the people of England, to bring those who were wandering in darkness and error to the true light and knowledge of thee: grant us so to walk in that light, that we may come at last to the light of everlasting life. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-2.name: St. Stephen of Hungary, K.C.
9-2.collect: GRANT unto thy Church, we beseech thee, Almighty God; that as she had a zealous companion in blessed Stephen thy Confessor whilst he reigned on earth, so may she deserve to have him as a glorious protector in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-2.name: The Raising of St. Lazarus
9-2.collect: O GOD, the resurrection and the life, who didst raise thy blessed disciple Saint Lazarus from the grave after he had been dead four days: grant, we beseech thee, at his intercession; that the heart of stone being taken away from us, we may rise again from the death of sin. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-8.name: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
9-8.collect: HEARKEN, O merciful God, unto the supplications of thy servants; that we, who are gathered together to celebrate the Nativity of the Virgin Mother of God, may at her intercession be delivered by thee from whatsoever perils and dangers may beset us. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-9.name: St. Peter Claver, P.C.
9-9.collect: O GOD, who, to bring enslaved Negroes to the knowledge of thy Name, didst strengthen blessed Peter with wonderful love and patience to succour them: grant us through his intercession, that seeking the things that belong to Jesus Christ, we may show forth charity toward our neighbours both in deed and in truth. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-12.name: The Holy Name of Mary
9-12.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God: that we thy faithful people, who rejoice in the Name and in the advocacy of the most holy Virgin Mary; may by her loving intercession be delivered upon earth from all evil, and attain in heaven to everlasting felicity. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-14.name: Exaltation of the Holy Cross
9-14.collect: O God, who hast vouchsafed to redeem the human race by the precious Blood of thine only-begotten Son Jesus Christ: mercifully grant, that we who come together to adore his life-giving Cross may be delivered from the bonds of our sins. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-15.name: The Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin
9-15.collect: O GOD, in whose Passion the sword of grief did pierce the gentle soul of the glorious Virgin Mary, thy Mother, that so might be fulfilled the word of thy Prophet Simeon: mercifully grant, that we who devoutly call to mind her sorrows, may be fulfilled with the blessed fruits of thy Passion; who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-16.name: Sts. Cornelius & Cyprian, BB.MM.
9-16.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that as we thy Christian people do assemble together for the solemnity of thine holy priests Cornelius and Cyprian: so may we enjoy in heaven that which we devoutly celebrate upon earth. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-16.name: St. Ninian of Galloway, B.C.
9-16.collect: O GOD, who by thy blessed Bishop Ninian, didst cause the light of the Gospel to shine forth in the British Isles, fortifying thy Church as a stronghold in the gloom of heathenism, and a lighthouse diffusing learning and piety; grant that thy servants, aided by his intercession, may become sons of the new birth, ever challenging the false and witnessing to the true. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-17.name: St. Lambert, B.M.
