9-17.collect: WE beseech thee, O Lord, that the prayer of holy Lambert thy Bishop and Martyr may commend us unto thee; and as his glorious passion doth adorn this day, so may we be ever defended by his assistance. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-17.name: St. Hildegard of Bingen, V.
9-17.collect: O GOD, by whose grace thine handmaiden Hildegard, kindled with the fire of thy love, became a burning and shining lamp in thy Church: grant that we also may be aflame with the spirit of love and discipline, and walk before thee as children of light. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-19.name: St. Theodore, B.C.
9-19.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who didst inspire and enable thy servant Theodore of Tarsus, regardless of self, to accept thy call to rule and reform our land in its day of need: Preserve for us those blessings of Orthodox faith and Catholic discipline which through him thou didst bestow; and grant to his successors a double portion of his spirit. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-20.name: Eve of St. Matthew
9-20.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that the coming festival of thy blessed Apostle Matthew may both increase our devotion, and set forward our salvation. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-21.name: St. Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist
9-21.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who by thy blessed Son didst call Matthew from the receipt of custom to be an Apostle and Evangelist; Grant us grace to forsake all covetous desires, and inordinate love of riches, and to follow the same thy Son Jesus Christ, who liveth and reigneth with thee and the Holy Ghost, one God, world without end. Amen.

9-22.name: St. Maurice & Companions, MM.
9-22.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God; that the solemn festival of thine holy Martyrs Maurice and his Companions may cause us to rejoice, that we may glory in the heavenly birthday of those upon whose prayers we rely. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-22.name: St. Thomas of Villanova, B.C.
9-22.collect: O GOD, who didst adorn the blessed Bishop Thomas with the virtue of signal loving-kindness toward the poor: we beseech thee, that by his intercession thou wouldest generously pour out the riches of thy gracious mercy upon all who call upon thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-25.name: Lancelot Andrewes, B.C.
9-25.collect: O LORD our heavenly Father, by whose grace the Church was enriched by the great learning and eloquent preaching of thy Bishop and Confessor Lancelot, but even more so by his example of biblical and liturgical prayer: conform our lives to the image of Christ; that our hearts may love thee, our minds serve thee, and our lips proclaim the greatness of thy mercy. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-28.name: St. Wenceslaus, K.M.
9-28.collect: O GOD, who by the victory of martyrdom didst exalt blessed Wenceslaus from earthly rule to the glory of thine heavenly kingdom: grant, we pray thee, that by his merits and intercession, we may be made heirs of the King of kings. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

9-29.name: St. Michael and All Angels
9-29.collect: O EVERLASTING God, who hast ordained and constituted the services of Angels and men in a wonderful order; Mercifully grant that, as thy holy Angels always do thee service in heaven, so, by thy appointment, they may succour and defend us on earth; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

9-30.name: St. Jerome, P.C.D.
9-30.collect: O GOD, who hast vouchsafed through blessed Jerome thy Confessor and Priest to reveal unto us the truth of Holy Scripture and the mystery of the Sacraments: grant us, instructed by his teaching and holpen by his prayers, so to learn of thee according to thine holy Word, that we may find in it the light that shineth more and more unto the perfect day. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-1.name: St. Remigius & Companions, BB.CC.
10-1.collect: O GOD, who chosest thy servant Remigius with his Companions to be the harbingers of salvation to the King and whole nation of the Franks: hasten, we pray thee, the almighty working of thy providence, whereby the kings and chiefs of untaught lands bring in their glory and honour, to take their destined place within the Holy City of thy perfected Church. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-2.name: The Holy Guardian Angels
10-2.collect: O GOD, who in thine ineffable providence dost vouchsafe to send thine holy Angels to guard us: grant, of thy bountiful goodness; that we thine humble servants may ever continue in safety under their protection, and hereafter rejoice in their abiding fellowship. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-3.name: St. Thérèse of Lisieux, V.
10-3.collect: O LORD Jesus Christ, who hast said, Except ye become as little children ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven: grant us, we beseech thee, in meekness and simplicity of heart so to follow the footsteps of blessed Thérèse thy Virgin, that we may at last come unto thine everlasting kingdom. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-4.name: St. Francis, C.
10-4.collect: O GOD, who by the merits of blessed Francis dost increase thy Church with a new offspring: grant, we beseech thee, that after his pattern we may learn to count the wisdom of this world as foolishness, and determine to know nothing save Jesus Christ and him crucified. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-6.name: St. Bruno, C.
10-6.collect: May we be assisted, O Lord, we beseech thee, by the intercessions of holy Bruno thy Confessor; that we who have grievously offended thy Majesty by our transgressions, may through his merits and prayers obtain the pardon of all our faults. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-7.name: The Most Holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary
10-7.collect: O GOD, whose only-begotten Son, by his life, death, and resurrection, hath purchased for us the rewards of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech thee, that meditating upon the mysteries of the Most Holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may both imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-7.name: Sts. Simeon and Anna
10-7.collect: O GOD, who by the light of thy Spirit didst reveal to just Simeon the Light of the world, and to holy Anna him that should redeem Israel: grant, we beseech thee, that we likewise devoutly serving thee with fastings and prayers, may also obtain in joy and gladness the rewards of the righteous. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-8.name: St. Bridget of Sweden, W.
10-8.collect: O GOD, who by thine only-begotten Son didst reveal heavenly secrets to blessed Bridget: grant through her loving intercession, that we thy servants may rejoice and be glad in the revelation of thine everlasting glory. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-9.name: St. Denys, B.M., & Companions, MM.
10-9.collect: O GOD, who on this day didst strengthen thy blessed Bishop Denys with the virtue of constancy in suffering, and didst vouchsafe to associate Rusticus and Eleutherius with him in preaching thy glory to the heathen: grant us, we beseech thee, constancy in thy faith and truth; that we may be stablished in divine love, and moved from its perfection by no temptations. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-12.name: St. Wilfrid of York, B.C.
10-12.collect: O GOD, the light of the faithful and shepherd of souls, who didst set blessed Wilfrid to be a Bishop in thy Church, that he might feed thy sheep by his word and guide them by his example: Grant us, we beseech thee, through his wondrous merits and prayers; both to keep the faith which he taught, and ever to seek after the things of heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-13.name: St. Edward the Confessor, K.C.
10-13.collect: O GOD, who didst call Saint Edward the Confessor from the tottering eminence of an earthly realm, to rest in the secure glory of thine heavenly kingdom: grant us, we pray thee; so to venerate him on earth, that we may be found worthy to reign with him in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-15.name: Our Lady of Walsingham
10-15.collect: O GOD, who through the mystery of the Word made flesh, didst in thy mercy sanctify the house of the Blessed Virgin Mary: do thou grant that we, who honour her Shrine at Walsingham, may keep aloof from the tabernacle of sinners, and become worthy indwellers of thine house. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-15.name: St. Teresa of Avila, V.
10-15.collect: Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we do rejoice in the festivity of blessed Teresa thy Virgin, so may we also be nourished with the food of her heavenly doctrine, and be taught in the spirit of her loving devotion. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-16.name: St. Hedwig, W.
10-16.collect: O GOD, who didst teach thy blessed Saint Hedwig, forsaking the pomps and vanities of this life, to follow thee steadfastly in the lowly bearing of thy Cross: mercifully grant that, by her merits and example, we may learn to trample underfoot the contemptible pleasures of this world; and cleaving steadfastly to thy Cross, to overcome all things that are contrary to our salvation. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-17.name: St. Margaret Mary, V.
10-17.collect: O LORD Jesus Christ, who didst wondrously reveal to the Virgin, blessed Margaret Mary, the unsearchable riches of thine Heart: grant unto us by her merits and example, that loving thee in all things and above all things, we may be worthy always to have a dwelling-place in that most gracious Heart of thine. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-17.name: St. Etheldreda, V.
10-17.collect: O GOD, who art the Spouse of virgin souls, the refreshment of the pure in heart, and the salvation of all them that love thee: mercifully grant that we, who reverently celebrate the feast of thy blessed Virgin Etheldreda, may through her prayers obtain mercy of thy divine majesty. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-18.name: St. Luke the Evangelist
10-18.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who didst inspire thy servant Saint Luke the Physician, to set forth in the Gospel the love and healing power of thy Son; Manifest in thy Church the like power and love, to the healing of our bodies and our souls; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

10-19.name: St. Frideswide, V.
10-19.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God; that after the example of thine holy Virgin Frideswide, we may advance in the knowledge of the Saints, and show forth mercy to others: that, through her intercession, we may obtain forgiveness of our sins. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-24.name: St. Raphael the Archangel
10-24.collect: O GOD, who didst direct the Archangel Raphael to go before Tobias thy servant hastening on his journey, and didst give him as guardian amidst the changes and chances of life: grant that we, ever defended by his help, may so avoid the dangers of this present life, as to be enabled to attain unto the joys of heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-25.name: Sts. Crispin & Crispinian, MM.
10-25.collect: O GOD, who didst bestow upon blessed Crispin and Crispinian such a measure of thy grace, that they might obtain the crown of martyrdom: grant unto us thy servants remission of all our sins, that through the merits and intercessions of these thy Saints, we may be delivered from all adversities. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-27.name: Eve of St. Simon & St. Jude
10-27.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God; that like as we do approach the glorious birthday of thine Apostles Simon and Jude, so may they approach thy Majesty for us, that we may be made worthy of thy benefits. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

10-28.name: St. Simon & St. Jude the Apostles
10-28.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who hast built thy Church upon the foundation of the Apostles and Prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the head cornerstone; Grant us so to be joined together in unity of spirit by their doctrine, that we may be made an holy temple acceptable unto thee; through the same Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

10-31.name: All Hallows Even
10-31.collect: O LORD our God, increase, we pray thee, and multiply upon us the gifts of thy grace: that we, who do prevent the glorious Festival of all thy Saints, may of thee be enabled joyfully to follow them in all virtuous and godly living. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-1.name: The Feast of All Saints
11-1.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who hast knit together thine elect in one communion and fellowship, in the mystical body of thy Son Christ our Lord; Grant us grace so to follow thy blessed Saints in all virtuous and godly living, that we may come to those unspeakable joys which thou hast prepared for those who unfeignedly love thee; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

11-4.name: St. Charles Borromeo, B.C.
11-4.collect: Guard thy Church, O Lord, with the continual protection of holy Charles thy Confessor and Bishop; that as his pastoral care hath made him glorious, so his intercession may ever keep us fervent in thy love. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-5.name: Sts. Zacharias & Elisabeth
11-5.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God: that the examples of blessed Zacharias and Elisabeth may stir the wills of thy faithful people to better life and conversation, so that we who cherish their memory may indeed imitate their good and holy lives. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-6.name: St. Leonard, Abt. C.
11-6.collect: O GOD, by whose grace thy blessed Abbot Leonard became a burning and shining light in thy Church: grant that we, inflamed with the same spirit of discipline and love, may ever walk before thee in the way of perfection as children of light. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-7.name: All Anglican Saints and Martyrs
11-7.collect: ALMIGHTY God, we bless thine holy Name for all thy Saints, and most especially for all the Anglican saints and martyrs who have laboured in thy vineyard; endow us, we beseech thee, with minds clear, faith firm, courage true, and charity thorough; that we, following their examples, may keep thy commandments with boldness: having innocency in simplicity, peaceableness in love, modesty in lowliness, diligence in service, watchfulness in helping those who toil, mercifulness in succouring the poor, constancy in defending the truth, and severity in keeping discipline; for these are the footprints which the Saints have left us, even as they returned to their true fatherland, that we, treading in their steps, might follow them into joy. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-8.name: The Octave Day of All Saints
11-8.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who hast knit together thine elect in one communion and fellowship, in the mystical body of thy Son Christ our Lord; Grant us grace so to follow thy blessed Saints in all virtuous and godly living, that we may come to those unspeakable joys which thou hast prepared for those who unfeignedly love thee; through the same thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

11-11.name: St. Martin of Tours, B.C.
11-11.collect: O LORD Jesus Christ, who didst endue thy soldier Martin with the spirit of sacrifice, and didst exalt him as Bishop to be a great defender of the Faith: grant us grace so to follow in his holy footsteps, that at the last we may be found clothed with righteousness, in the dwellings of peace. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-14.name: Bestowal of the Episcopate in America
11-14.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who by thy Son Jesus Christ didst give to thy holy Apostles many excellent gifts, and didst charge them to feed thy flock; Give grace, we beseech thee, to all Bishops, the Pastors of thy Church, that they may diligently preach thy Word, and duly administer the godly Discipline thereof; and grant to the people, that they may obediently follow the same; that all may receive the crown of everlasting glory. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-15.name: St. Albert the Great, B.C.D.
11-15.collect: O GOD, who didst make blessed Albert thy Bishop and Doctor great in subordinating human wisdom to divine faith: grant us, we beseech thee, so closely to follow in the ways of his teaching, that we may enjoy thy perfect light in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-16.name: St. Edmund of Canterbury, B.C.
11-16.collect: O GOD, who according to thy bountiful goodness hast adorned thy Church with the merits of the excellent life of blessed Edmund thy Confessor, and hast made it glad by his glorious miracles: favourably grant unto us thy servants, that after his example we may amend our lives, and under his patronage be defended from all adversities. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-16.name: St. Gertrude, V.
11-16.collect: O GOD, who didst prepare for thyself a joyful habitation in the pure heart of the blessed Virgin Gertrude: mercifully cleanse our hearts from every stain through her merits and intercession, and grant that we may rejoice in fellowship with her. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-17.name: St. Hugh of Lincoln, B.C.
11-17.collect: O MERCIFUL Father, who didst endow thy servant Hugh of Lincoln with a wise and cheerful boldness, and didst teach him how to commend the discipline of holy life to kings and princes: grant that we, fearing only thy displeasure, may learn to speak the truth with boldness in the name of thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-18.name: St. Hilda of Whitby, V. Abs.
11-18.collect: O GOD, the author of all virtues, by whose gift thy blessed Abbess Hilda chose the heavenly vision before the fleeting glories of this world: grant that we may learn by her example to despise the passing things of earth, and to seek after the things which are eternal. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-20.name: St. Edmund the Martyr, K.
11-20.collect: O GOD of ineffable compassion, who didst endue the blessed King Edmund with grace to overcome his enemies by dying for thy Name: mercifully grant, that we thy servants may, at his intercession, be enabled to vanquish and overcome the assaults and allurements of our ancient enemy. Through Jesus Christ our Lord, to whom be all glory and dominion, world without end. Amen.

11-21.name: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
11-21.collect: O GOD, who didst will that blessed Mary ever-Virgin, the habitation of the Holy Ghost, should this day be presented in the temple of the Lord: grant, we beseech thee, that we who honour the feast of her Presentation, may ourselves be made a temple in which thou shalt be pleased to dwell. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-22.name: St. Cæcilia, V.M.
11-22.collect: O GOD, who makest us glad with the yearly festival of blessed Cæcilia, thy Virgin and Martyr: grant that we who honour her with duteous service, may also follow the example of her good and holy life. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-23.name: St. Clement, B.M.
11-23.collect: O LORD, who in every age dost write names in thy Book of Life, and dost lead the meek of the earth to be followers of the Lamb of God: raise up to us teachers like unto thy Bishop and Martyr Clement, the disciple of thy first Apostles; who, by their writings, may instruct the Church without thought of self, and open unto us healing fountains of repentance, peace, and love. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-23.name: St. Felicitas, W.M.
11-23.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, O holy Father; that as blessed Felicitas for her wholeness of faith and excellence of life is esteemed before thy Majesty with exceeding favour, so by her prayers she may render us equally acceptable and devoted unto thee. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-24.name: St. John of the Cross, C.D.
11-24.collect: O GOD, who madest holy John thy Confessor and Doctor a great lover of the Cross and of perfect self-denial: grant, that by continually cleaving to his example, we may attain unto eternal glory. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-25.name: St. Katharine of Alexandria, V.M.
11-25.collect: O GOD, who didst give the Law unto Moses on the top of Mount Sinai, and there wondrously didst place by thine Angels the body of blessed Katharine thy Virgin and Martyr: grant, we beseech thee, that through her merits and intercession, we may be enabled to reach that Mount which is Christ. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-29.name: The Eve of St. Andrew
11-29.collect: WE beseech thee, Almighty God, that blessed Andrew thine Apostle, whose feast we do prevent, may implore for us thine aid; that all our guilt being done away, we may merit to be rescued from all perils. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

11-30.name: St. Andrew the Apostle
11-30.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who didst give such grace unto thy holy Apostle Saint Andrew, that he readily obeyed the calling of thy Son Jesus Christ, and followed him without delay; Grant unto us all, that we, being called by thy holy Word, may forthwith give up ourselves obediently to fulfil thy holy commandments; through the same Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

12-2.name: St. Peter Chrysologus, B.C.D.
12-2.collect: O GOD, who by divine foreshowing wast pleased to summon thy great teacher Saint Peter Chrysologus to be a ruler and Doctor of thy Church: grant, we beseech thee, that as we have learned of him the doctrine of life on earth, so we may be found worthy to have him for our advocate in heaven. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-3.name: St. Francis Xavier, C.
12-3.collect: O GOD, who didst will to gather into thy Church the peoples of the Indies by the preaching and miracles of blessed Francis: graciously grant, that we who reverence his glorious merits may also imitate the pattern of his virtues. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-6.name: St. Nicholas, B.C.
12-6.collect: O GOD, who didst adorn blessed Nicholas thy Bishop with very many wondrous miracles: grant, we beseech thee, that through his merits and prayers we may be delivered from the flames of hell. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-7.name: St. Ambrose, B.C.D.
12-7.collect: O GOD, who didst adorn blessed Ambrose thy Confessor and Bishop both with clarity of faith and strength of merit: grant, by his intercession, that both our minds may be secured in the certainty of that faith which he taught, and that we at length may obtain to the fellowship of eternal glory. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-7.name: The Octave Day of St. Andrew
12-7.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who didst give such grace unto thy holy Apostle Saint Andrew, that he readily obeyed the calling of thy Son Jesus Christ, and followed him without delay; Grant unto us all, that we, being called by thy holy Word, may forthwith give up ourselves obediently to fulfil thy holy commandments; through the same Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

12-8.name: The Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
12-8.collect: Regard, we beseech thee, O merciful God, the supplications of thy servants: that we, who are gathered together to celebrate the Conception of the Virgin Mother of God, may at her intercession be delivered by thee from whatsoever perils and dangers may threaten us. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-15.name: The Octave Day of the Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
12-15.collect: Regard, we beseech thee, O merciful God, the supplications of thy servants: that we, who are gathered together to celebrate the Conception of the Virgin Mother of God, may at her intercession be delivered by thee from whatsoever perils and dangers may threaten us. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-21.name: St. Thomas the Apostle
12-21.collect: ALMIGHTY and everliving God, who, for the greater confirmation of the faith, didst suffer thy holy Apostle Thomas to be doubtful in thy Son's resurrection; Grant us so perfectly, and without all doubt, to believe in thy Son Jesus Christ, that our faith in thy sight may never be reproved. Hear us, O Lord, through the same Jesus Christ, to whom, with thee and the Holy Ghost, be all honour and glory, now and for evermore. Amen.

12-25.name: The Nativity of Our Lord Jesus Christ
12-25.collect: ALMIGHTY God, who hast given us thy only-begotten Son to take our nature upon him, and as at this time to be born of a pure Virgin; Grant that we being regenerate, and made thy children by adoption and grace, may daily be renewed by thy Holy Spirit; through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, who liveth and reigneth with thee and the same Spirit ever, one God, world without end. Amen.

12-26.name: St. Stephen, Deacon and Martyr
12-26.collect: GRANT, O Lord, that, in all our sufferings here upon earth for the testimony of thy truth, we may steadfastly look up to heaven, and by faith behold the glory that shall be revealed; and, being filled with the Holy Ghost, may learn to love and bless our persecutors by the example of thy first Martyr Saint Stephen, who prayed for his murderers to thee, O blessed Jesus, who standest at the right hand of God to succour all those who suffer for thee, our only Mediator and Advocate. Amen.

12-27.name: St. John, Apostle and Evangelist
12-27.collect: MERCIFUL Lord, we beseech thee to cast thy bright beams of light upon thy Church, that it, being illumined by the doctrine of thy blessed Apostle and Evangelist Saint John, may so walk in the light of thy truth, that it may at length attain to life everlasting; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

12-28.name: Holy Innocents, Martyrs
12-28.collect: O ALMIGHTY God, who out of the mouths of babes and sucklings hast ordained strength, and madest infants to glorify thee by their deaths; Mortify and kill all vices in us, and so strengthen us by thy grace, that by the innocency of our lives, and constancy of our faith even unto death, we may glorify thy holy Name; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

12-29.name: St. Thomas of Canterbury, B.M.
12-29.collect: O GOD, in behalf of whose Church the glorious Bishop Thomas fell by the swords of wicked men: grant, we beseech thee, that all who implore his aid may obtain the wholesome effect of his petitions. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

12-31.name: St. Sylvester, B.C.
12-31.collect: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that the reverend solemnity of Blessed Sylvester thy Confessor and Bishop, may both increase our devotion and set forward our salvation. Through Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

39.name: The Ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ
39.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that like as we do believe thy only-begotten Son our Lord Jesus Christ to have ascended into the heavens; so we may also in heart and mind thither ascend, and with him continually dwell, who liveth and reigneth with thee and the Holy Ghost, one God, world without end. Amen.

46.name: The Octave Day of the Ascension
46.collect: GRANT, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that like as we do believe thy only-begotten Son our Lord Jesus Christ to have ascended into the heavens; so we may also in heart and mind thither ascend, and with him continually dwell, who liveth and reigneth with thee and the Holy Ghost, one God, world without end. Amen.

60.name: The Most Holy Body of Christ
60.collect: O God, who in a wonderful Sacrament hast left unto us a memorial of thy Passion: Grant us so to venerate the sacred mysteries of thy Body and Blood, that we may ever perceive within ourselves the fruit of thy redemption; who livest and reignest with the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, one God, world without end. Amen.

67.name: The Octave Day of Corpus Christi
67.collect: O God, who in a wonderful Sacrament hast left unto us a memorial of thy Passion: Grant us so to venerate the sacred mysteries of thy Body and Blood, that we may ever perceive within ourselves the fruit of thy redemption; who livest and reignest with the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, one God, world without end. Amen.

68.name: The Most Sacred Heart of Jesus
68.collect: O God, who in the Heart of thy Son, wounded by our sins, dost vouchsafe mercifully to bestow upon us the infinite treasures of love: grant, we beseech thee, that whilst we offer him the homage of our loving devotion, we may also show forth the duty of worthy satisfaction. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

75.name: The Octave Day of the Sacred Heart
75.collect: O God, who in the Heart of thy Son, wounded by our sins, dost vouchsafe mercifully to bestow upon us the infinite treasures of love: grant, we beseech thee, that whilst we offer him the homage of our loving devotion, we may also show forth the duty of worthy satisfaction. Through the same Jesus Christ thy Son our Lord, who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

-9.name: The Compassion of the Blessed Virgin Mary
-9.collect: We beseech thee, O Lord Jesus Christ, that now and at the hour of our death, the Blessed Virgin Mary, thy Mother, may intercede for us at thy mercy seat: whose most sacred soul in the hour of thy Passion was pierced by the sword of sorrow, and whom exceeding joy did make glad in thy glorious Resurrection. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.

holyFamily.name: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph
holyFamily.collect: O LORD Jesus Christ, who becoming subject to Mary and Joseph hast hallowed home-life with unspeakable virtues: make us, holpen by their prayers, to be instructed by the example of thy Holy Family, and to obtain everlasting fellowship with them. Who livest and reignest with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, ever one God, world without end. Amen.
